# Animate with separate image variations

[All prompts](../README.md#collection) · [中文](#中文) · [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)

Use separate edited frames when a sprite grid distorts the character too much.

**Editor adaptation · Multi-step workflow · Source-checked 2026-09-10 · Not independently tested**

<a href="https://x.com/elle_elle_e/status/2097439673308389840"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRuaOTLa8AABSjw?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="560" alt="Animate with separate image variations — @elle_elle_e source example" loading="lazy"></a>

Source example by [@elle_elle_e](https://x.com/elle_elle_e/status/2097439673308389840). This is the creator’s source result, not a verified output of the adapted prompt below.

## Prompt

### Step 1

```text
Create nine separate variations of the supplied character image for a gentle animation. Change the pose only slightly between frames. Keep the character’s size, position, identity, and background consistent.
```

### Step 2

```text
Inspect and align the frames, then assemble them into a looping GIF. If the motion needs more in-between frames, create another set using the same references.
```

## Required inputs

- A character image; image editing and GIF assembly tools.

## Notes

- Editorial workflow adaptation. The creator reports using two sets of nine separate variations after a 3-by-3 sheet changed the design too much.
- The original base image was made with Nano Banana Pro; GPT Image 2.5 was used for subsequent edits.

[Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com) and paste the prompt into the appropriate image workflow. This link currently opens the homepage and does not prefill the prompt. GIF and file-export recipes need additional processing tools.

## 中文

### 通过独立差分帧制作动画

精灵表导致角色变形时，改用独立编辑的差分帧。

**编辑改写 · 多步骤工作流 · 已核对原帖 · 尚未独立生图测试**

预览是原作者帖中的示例，并非本仓库使用下方提示词重新生成的结果。

### 提示词

步骤 1：

```text
基于提供的角色图，创建九张独立差分图用于轻柔动画。每帧只轻微改变姿势，保持角色大小、位置、身份和背景一致。
```

步骤 2：

```text
检查并对齐各帧，再组装循环 GIF。若需要更多中间帧，使用相同参考再生成一组。
```

### 输入要求

- 角色图；图像编辑与 GIF 组装工具。

### 使用说明

- 这是工作流编辑改写。作者报告 3×3 精灵表导致设计变化过大，随后改为两组各九张独立差分图。
- 原始底图由 Nano Banana Pro 制作，后续编辑使用 GPT Image 2.5。
